history.summary: A 743 sqft freehold 1BR in D14 Mountbatten at $1.2M ($1,615 PSF). The listed PSF sits notably below the project's URA median of $1,830, but a $1.2M 1BR is an oversized/expensive one-bed that competes against far cheaper 1BRs and entry 2BRs in the same band.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold D14 near Mountbatten (CC7, 570m) is a respectable location with steady ~3.8%/yr resale appreciation, and the $1,615 PSF is ~12% under the $1,830 URA median — but only 7 URA transactions make that rate thin. At 743 sqft this is a large 1BR; $1.2M for a one-bedroom narrows the buyer pool to investors and singles, and the high elo masks weak exit liquidity for a $1.2M 1BR. Yield is the saving grace; appreciation case is average.

history.summary: Quirky 743 sqft freehold maisonette (not a true 1BR) in a tiny 45-unit D14 project; modest discount but very thin data and split-level layout limit liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: The unit is mislabeled: at 743 sqft this is a Cosmo Maisonette (built-up 743-818 sqft), a split-level layout, not a flat 1BR. Maisonettes list at ~$1,700-1,750 PSF and a 710 sqft unit transacted at $1,830 PSF in Sep 2025, so the asking $1,615 PSF is genuinely a touch below comps - supporting the -10.3% age-adj direction. But every supporting signal is thin: appreciation_txns = 7 and psf_cohort_txns = 4 in a 45-unit development, so confidence in the discount being real (vs a quirky-layout discount) is low. Freehold is NOT a forward edge per v3.4. D14 is RCR-adjacent (mid forward region). Maisonettes have a narrower buyer pool and weaker exit liquidity. Modest value plus quirky, illiquid format and thin data nets to Neutral, low confidence.
red_flags: 743 sqft unit is a split-level maisonette, not a standard 1BR - narrow buyer pool, weaker exit
Only 45 units total; appreciation_txns = 7 and psf_cohort_txns = 4 - very thin price discovery
Older Geylang-fringe (Guillemard) location - rental tenant pool and resale sentiment can be patchy
catalysts: Freehold tenure (a livability plus, but not a forward-return edge)
Within MRT reach of Mountbatten/Aljunied; ~10-15min to CBD
